claims.text: The hotel sits on the corner of Peachtree and Piedmont, at Buckhead's busiest intersection.

findings.quote: On the corner of Peachtree and Piedmont, the Grand Hyatt Atlanta holds court over Buckhead’s busiest intersection.
findings.note: The review states both the corner location and the busiest-intersection description.

claims.text: The Japanese Zen garden has winding paths, a bridge and a 30-foot waterfall.

findings.quote: Give yourself over to tranquility with winding paths, a bridge, the soothing sound of our 30-foot waterfall and plenty of greenery in our garden
findings.note: Covers the winding paths, the bridge and the 30-foot waterfall.

claims.text: The Zen garden is visible from the restaurant, the lobby bar and the outdoor pool deck.

findings.quote: It’s visible from the restaurant and lobby bar, as well as the outdoor pool deck.
findings.note: Refers to the Zen garden described in the preceding sentence.

claims.text: Suites can include separate sitting areas, private balconies, wet bars, kitchenettes or extra half-baths.

findings.quote: Select one of our luxury suites and enjoy additional amenities such as separate sitting areas, private balconies, wet bars, kitchenettes or extra half-baths.
findings.note: Lists all five suite features named in the claim.

claims.text: Pure hypo-allergenic rooms have an air purification system and hypoallergenic treatment of all fabrics and surfaces.

findings.quote: an air purification system, hypoallergenic treatment of all fabrics and surfaces
findings.note: Taken from the Pure - Hypo-Allergenic Rooms description.

claims.text: The Grand Club lounge has a private entry and a dedicated concierge.

findings.quote: Enjoy Grand Club access with an exclusive private-entry lounge featuring a dedicated concierge
findings.note: Establishes both the private entry and the dedicated concierge.

claims.text: The fitness center has cardio and wellness equipment by Peloton, Technogym and LifeFitness.

findings.quote: state-of-the-art fitness center featuring cardio and wellness equipment by Peloton, Technogym and LifeFitness

claims.text: Peloton bikes can be delivered to guest rooms.

findings.quote: to Peloton bike rentals delivered to your room
findings.note: States that rented Peloton bikes are delivered to guest rooms.

findings.quote: Whether you're planning a relaxing afternoon by the pool, or joining us for happy hour or outdoor yoga, elevating your visit is just a click away.

claims.text: The hotel welcomes dogs and offers hypoallergenic pet beds and bowls on request.

findings.quote: We are happy to welcome your traveling canine companions to our pet-friendly hotel in Buckhead. We offer the following for our furry friends on request: hypoallergenic Pet Beds and Pet Bowls.
findings.note: Covers welcoming dogs and the on-request hypoallergenic pet beds and bowls.

claims.text: The MARTA Buckhead Station is two blocks from the hotel.

findings.quote: The Buckhead Station is two blocks from our hotel.
findings.note: Given in the MARTA transit section.

claims.text: Cassis is on the lower lobby level next to the Zen garden, with indoor and outdoor seating.

findings.quote: Located on the lower lobby level next to our Zen Garden, Cassis offers a delightful upscale dining experience with indoor and outdoor seating.
findings.note: Covers the location, the Zen garden adjacency and the indoor and outdoor seating.

claims.text: The Japanese Zen garden includes an azumaya, an open tea house.

findings.quote: feng shui Japanese Zen garden, complete with an azumaya (open tea house) and cascading waterfall
findings.note: Names the azumaya and defines it as an open tea house.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has views of Stone Mountain and downtown Atlanta, a private balcony with furniture and a regulation-size pool table.

findings.quote: Entertain amid views of Stone Mountain and downtown Atlanta in this 2,500 square-foot suite featuring one king bed, a private 450-square-foot balcony with furniture, a regulation-size pool table
findings.note: Covers the views, the furnished private balcony and the pool table.

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites offer views of the Buckhead neighborhood, Atlanta's skyline, Stone Mountain or the Japanese Zen garden.

findings.quote: provides splendid views of the surrounding Buckhead neighborhood, Atlanta's skyline, Stone Mountain or our peaceful Japanese Zen garden.
findings.note: Lists all four view types named in the claim.

claims.text: The Fabled is a cocktail bar and restaurant beside the garden and waterfall, featuring Georgia ingredients and garden-fresh herbs.

findings.quote: The Fabled, beside our serene garden and waterfall, is Atlanta’s cocktail bar and culinary destination. Featuring Georgia’s finest local ingredients, garden-fresh herbs, and Southern elegance
findings.note: "Culinary destination" supports the restaurant element; the location and ingredients are also covered.

claims.text: Buckhead Village District, Lenox Square mall and Phipps Plaza are within minutes of the hotel.

findings.quote: Discover everything that our exciting Atlanta suburb of Buckhead has to offer — it’s all within minutes of our hotel.
findings.note: Establishes that Buckhead's offerings are within minutes of the hotel.

findings.quote: Or, stay in Buckhead with the world-class shops and restaurants at Buckhead Village District, Lenox Square mall, Phipps Plaza and much more.

claims.text: The hotel draws a significant business and convention crowd.

findings.quote: The hotel draws a significant business and convention crowd, as well as fans in town for a big game.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban city-center setting may not suit travelers seeking a quiet, resort-style escape.
